description: A ping pong delay set in beats per minute, bouncing the repeats between the two outputs, with a send and return on each side

params.text: Sets the tempo the delay time is worked out from, 30 to 240 beats per minute
Sets the delay as a note length at that tempo: 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 or 1/32
Sets what is done to that note length: nn leaves it alone, dot makes it half as long again, and trip makes it a triplet
Sets how much of the right repeat is fed back into the delay, 0 to 1
Sets how much of the delayed sound is heard against the untouched signal, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Sets the tempo by voltage in place of the knob, one octave per volt with 0V at 120 beats per minute, from -2V for 30 to 1V for 240
Sets the feedback by voltage in place of the knob, 0-10V across none to full
Sets that balance by voltage in place of the knob, 0-10V across dry to wet
Takes the left repeat back from an effect, replacing what went out at the Send jack beside it
Takes the right repeat back from an effect, replacing what went out at the Send jack beside it

outputs.text: The left side of the delay mixed with the untouched signal
The right side of the delay mixed with the untouched signal
Carries the left repeat before it reaches the output, for patching an effect into that side; it works only while the Ret jack beside it is patched too
Carries the right repeat before it reaches the output, for patching an effect into that side; it works only while the Ret jack beside it is patched too

notes: the signal goes through the left delay first and then the right, which is what makes the repeats bounce from side to side
the reading above the BPM knob is the tempo in use, which a cable in the BPM jack moves

inputs.1:
-2 to 1V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the BPM knob.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Feedback knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Dry/Wet knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
